info.title: AXLR Bots GitHub hooks
info.description: The input adapter that turns GitHub's webhooks into the dev team's events (docs/architecture/team-topics.md, «Where GitHub's facts come from», option A; the pattern is docs/architecture/input-adapters.md). It receives `check_suite` and `pull_request` deliveries on `POST /github`, verifies `X-Hub-Signature-256` with the hook's secret, and publishes `pr.ci` and `pr.mergeada` to team `dev` as the operator, through the control plane's socket (`POST /v1/groups/{team}/events`). Only the fields the adapter reads are described: GitHub sends many more, and they are ignored. `axlr-bots github-hooks redeliver` reads GitHub's REST answers `Hook` and `HookDelivery` through `gh api`; they are described here too, so that no DTO of the package is written by hand. The wire forms are `adapters/githubhooks`; the runbook is docs/runbooks/github-hooks.md.

gateway.description: The gateway GitHub posts to (on gx10, an EC2 host: docs/runbooks/github-hooks.md), with a self-signed certificate (the hook has insecure_ssl=1: the HMAC is the authentication). It forwards /github through a reverse SSH tunnel to the adapter on gx10.

adapter.description: `axlr-bots github-hooks serve`, on loopback; the tunnel's far end.

controlPlane.description: The control plane's operator API over its Unix socket (<state>/axlr-bots.sock): the adapter publishes as the operator, at depth 0.

githubWebhook.title: GitHub's webhook
githubWebhook.description: POST only (405 otherwise), body at most 1 MiB (413). A missing or wrong X-Hub-Signature-256 is 401, logged without the body. `ping` and every event the adapter does not use are 204. A missing or malformed X-GitHub-Delivery, or a body that is not JSON, is 400. A repository outside the allow-list, and an action the adapter does not map, are 204. Something published is 202; a publish that failed is 502, so GitHub records the delivery as failed and it can be redelivered.

teamEvents.title: The team's events
teamEvents.description: The operator API's publish route (docs/reference/operator-api.md). The same delivery published again names the same idempotency key, so the control plane answers the event it published before and delivers nothing twice.

team.description: The team the adapter publishes to: --team, dev by default.

receiveGitHubWebhook.summary: GitHub posts a delivery of the repository's hook (events check_suite and pull_request, content type json).

sendPrCi.summary: A check suite completed: one pr.ci per pull request it names (none, one or several).

sendPrMergeada.summary: A pull request was closed merged: one pr.mergeada. Closed unmerged publishes nothing.

checkSuite.name: check_suite
checkSuite.title: A check suite's activity
checkSuite.summary: Mapped only with action completed: a repository hook receives no other.

pullRequest.name: pull_request
pullRequest.title: A pull request's activity
pullRequest.summary: Mapped only with action closed and pull_request.merged true.

ping.name: ping
ping.title: GitHub's ping when a hook is created
ping.summary: Answered 204 once its signature verifies; the body is not read.

X-GitHub-Event.description: The event's name: check_suite, pull_request, ping; any other is answered 204.

X-GitHub-Delivery.description: The delivery's GUID, the same on a redelivery: the idempotency keys are built from it.

X-Hub-Signature-256.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the hook's secret, in hex; compared in constant time.

CheckSuiteEvent.description: The fields of GitHub's check_suite payload the adapter reads.

action.description: completed is mapped; anything else is ignored.

head_sha.description: The commit the suite ran on.

conclusion.description: success, failure, neutral, cancelled, timed_out, action_required, stale, skipped, startup_failure; null at GitHub before the suite completes, read as empty.

pull_requests.description: The open pull requests whose head is head_sha; empty for a push to a branch with none (or from a fork).

PullRequestEvent.description: The fields of GitHub's pull_request payload the adapter reads.

action.description: closed with pull_request.merged true is mapped; anything else is ignored.

merge_commit_sha.description: The merge commit on the base branch once merged; null at GitHub otherwise, read as empty.

full_name.description: owner/name; only the allow-list's are mapped (--repos, by default underpass-ai/kmp, underpass-ai/made, underpass-ai/axlr, underpass-ai/axlr-bots).

PRCIEvent.description: The operator API's publish body (application.PublishGroupEventCommand) for pr.ci.

head_sha.description: The commit the suite ran on.

conclusion.description: The suite's conclusion, as GitHub names it.

PRMergeadaEvent.description: The operator API's publish body (application.PublishGroupEventCommand) for pr.mergeada.

merge_sha.description: The merge commit on the base branch (GitHub's merge_commit_sha).

head_sha.description: The pull request's last head commit.

Hook.description: An item of GitHub's REST GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/hooks, read by redeliver: only the fields it uses.

url.description: Where GitHub posts; redeliver takes the hooks whose URL is --hook-url, or whose path is /github when it is not given.

HookDelivery.description: An item of GitHub's REST GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/hooks/{hook_id}/deliveries: one attempt. Every attempt of one event shares its guid.

guid.description: The event's X-GitHub-Delivery, shared by its redeliveries.

status_code.description: The adapter's HTTP answer; 0 when GitHub reached nothing (the tunnel down). Anything but 2xx is a failure.
